verdict.rationale: Bulk triage is a fair question for an email service, so the axis applies. The pack never documents selecting many conversations and archiving, labeling, or marking them done in one action. The 'Keyboard shortcuts' entry is only a page title with no content, and 'Achieve inbox zero' is a marketing tagline. JMAP's batched methodCalls is a developer building block, not a user-facing multi-select feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
